arXiv:2605.06455v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 5 月 7 日arXiv:2605.06455v1 [cs.AI] 07 May 2026

PrefixGuard：从大型语言模型代理跟踪到在线故障警告监视器PrefixGuard: From Large Language Model Agent Traces to Online Failure-Warning Monitors

Xinmiao Huang1, Jinwei Hu1, Rajarshi Roy1, Changshun Wu2, Yi Dong1,*, Xiaowei Huang1
1University of Liverpool  2Université Grenoble Alpes Corresponding author: xiaowei.huang@liverpool.ac.uk, yi.dong@liverpool.ac.uk
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理现在执行耗时的、使用工具的任务，其中最终结果检查可能来得太晚而无法进行干预。 在线警告需要对异构跟踪进行轻量级前缀监视器，但手工编写的事件模式很脆弱，并且部署时 LLM 判断成本高昂。 我们介绍Large language model (LLM) agents now execute long, tool-using tasks where final outcome checks can arrive too late for intervention. Online warning requires lightweight prefix monitors over heterogeneous traces, but hand-authored event schemas are brittle and deployment-time LLM judging is costly. We introduce前缀卫士PrefixGuard，一个具有离线功能的跟踪监控框架, a trace-to-monitor framework with an offline步视StepView入职步骤随后是监督监控培训。 StepView 从原始跟踪样本中引入确定性的类型步骤适配器，监视器从最终结果中学习事件抽象和前缀风险评分器。 纵观网络竞技场，induction step followed by supervised monitor training. StepView induces deterministic typed-step adapters from raw trace samples, and the monitor learns an event abstraction and prefix-risk scorer from terminal outcomes. Across WebArena,τ2\tau^{2}-Bench、SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench，最强的 PrefixGuard 监视器达到 0.900/0.710/0.533/0.557 AUPRC。使用每种表示中最强大的后端，它们比原始文本控件平均提高了 +0.137 AUPRC。在相同的前缀警告协议下，法学硕士法官仍然处于弱势。 我们还得出了精确召回曲线（AUPRC）下基于分数的面积的可观察性上限，该上限将监控错误与在观察到的前缀中缺乏证据的故障分开。 对于有限状态审计，事后确定性有限自动机 (DFA) 提取在 WebArena 和-Bench, SkillsBench, and TerminalBench, the strongest PrefixGuard monitors reach 0.900/0.710/0.533/0.557 AUPRC. Using the strongest backend within each representation, they improve over raw-text controls by an average of +0.137 AUPRC. LLM judges remain substantially weaker under the same prefix-warning protocol. We also derive an observability ceiling on score-based area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) that separates monitor error from failures lacking evidence in the observed prefix. For finite-state audit, post-hoc deterministic finite automaton (DFA) extraction remains compact on WebArena andτ2\tau^{2}-Bench（29 和 20 个州），但在 SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench 上扩展到 151 和 187 个州。 最后，第一警报诊断显示，强大的排名并不意味着部署实用性：WebArena 排名良好，但无法支持低误报警报，而-Bench (29 and 20 states) but expands to 151 and 187 states on SkillsBench and TerminalBench. Finally, first-alert diagnostics show that strong ranking does not imply deployment utility: WebArena ranks well yet fails to support low-false-alarm alerts, whereasτ2\tau^{2}-Bench 和 TerminalBench 保留了更多可操作的早期警报。 总之，这些结果使 PrefixGuard 成为一种实用的监控合成方法，可以在前缀警告转化为可行的干预措施时进行明确的诊断。-Bench and TerminalBench retain more actionable early alerts. Together, these results position PrefixGuard as a practical monitor-synthesis recipe with explicit diagnostics for when prefix warnings translate into actionable interventions.

1.  简介1.  Introduction

Frontier LLM 代理能够执行长期多步骤任务Frontier LLM agents capable of long-horizon multi-step tasks[38, 41]越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，例如自动化软件工程are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, such as automated software engineering[43], 网络安全, cybersecurity[16]和财务管理, and financial management[42]，在最终任务验证器触发之前，单个错误操作可能会造成不可逆转的损害。 这就产生了迫切的需求, where a single erroneous action can cause irreversible damage long before the final task verifier fires. This creates urgent demand for在线警告信号online warning signals该标志轨迹实时漂移至失败。 现有方法在互补维度上存在不足： (i) 经典运行时验证that flag trajectory drift toward failure in real time. Existing approaches fall short on complementary dimensions: (i) classical runtime verification[18, 5]假设从原始跟踪到事件有一个稳定的、手工编写的映射，这对于异构代理跟踪和不断发展的工具模式来说是脆弱的。 (ii) 法学硕士法官assumes a stable, hand-authored mapping from raw traces to events, which is brittle for heterogeneous agent traces and evolving tool schemas. (ii) LLM-as-judge[45]对于每个前缀部署来说太昂贵了。 (iii) 预测前缀分类器可以恢复信号，但本身不会产生校准的监测状态或可检查的符号伪影is too expensive for per-prefix deployment. (iii) predictive prefix classifiers can recover signal but do not by themselves yield calibrated monitor state or inspectable symbolic artifacts[36, 35]。 由此产生的挑战不仅是故障是否可以预测 前缀，但原始跟踪是否可以转换为在线监视器 其状态很便宜，其证据在跟踪格式中是稳定的，并且 当警告失败时，其限制是可诊断的。. The resulting challenge is not only whether failures are predictable from prefixes, but whether raw traces can be converted into an online monitor whose state is cheap, whose evidence is stable across trace formats, and whose limits are diagnosable when warning fails.

我们通过将在线前缀警告视为一种解决方法来解决这些限制We address these limitations by treating online prefix warning as a数据驱动跟踪以监控合成data-driven trace to monitor synthesis问题。 给定原始执行轨迹和最终结果，我们得出固定的problem. Given raw execution traces and terminal outcomes, we derive fixedHH步骤警告标签并学习监视器，无需手动创作事件字母表或步骤级根本原因注释。 该论文研究了四个问题，涵盖前缀警告信号、迹线表示、有限状态压缩以及排序风险评分是否可以支持低 FAR 警报。 最后一个问题将排名与部署实用性分开。-step warning labels and learn a monitor without hand-authoring the event alphabet or step-level root-cause annotations. The paper studies four questions covering prefix-warning signal, trace representation, finite-state compression, and whether ranked risk scores can support low-FAR alarms. The last question separates ranking from deployment utility.

我们呈现We present前缀卫士PrefixGuard，一个模块化的神经符号框架，用于跟踪监控合成。 PrefixGuard 首先通过以下方式寻址原始跟踪接口, a modular neural-symbolic framework for trace to monitor synthesis. PrefixGuard first addresses the raw-trace interface via步视StepView，这是一种 LLM 辅助的一次性离线归纳步骤，可为异构跟踪格式生成确定性适配器。 然后它训练一个, a one-time LLM-assisted offline induction step that generates deterministic adapters for heterogeneous trace formats. It then trains a可微事件抽象层differentiable event abstraction layer与可更换的监视器后端结合，从前缀警告目标中端到端地学习离散的故障对齐字母表。 评分后端可以是神经的或结构化的；训练后，硬符号还可以编译成确定性有限自动机（DFA）作为事后审计工件。 在本文中我们实例化了该框架（图jointly with a replaceable monitor backend, learning a discrete failure-aligned alphabet end-to-end from the prefix-warning objective. The scoring backend can be neural or structured; after training, hard symbols can also be compiled into deterministic finite automata (DFAs) as post-hoc audit artifacts. In this paper we instantiate the framework (Figure1）与 GRU、Transformer 和软 FSM 监视器以及提取的 DFA 审计一起，研究预测质量、校准和有限状态可审计性的边界。) with GRU, Transformer, and soft-FSM monitors, plus extracted DFA audits, to study prediction quality, calibration, and the boundary of finite-state auditability.

The evaluation uses these benchmarks as diagnostic regimes rather than a single leaderboard. Non-sequential probes show that outcome-labeled prefixes still contain learnable signal, motivating monitor synthesis rather than repeated LLM judging. An AUPRC ceiling provides a diagnostic for how much visible failure evidence could be recovered from trace-only prefixes.

我们强调四个主要贡献：We highlight four primary contributions:

  • •

    原始跟踪监视器合成。Raw-trace monitor synthesis.我们在线制定 前缀警告作为来自原始 LLM 代理跟踪的监视器合成，以及 引入 PrefixGuard，它避免了手工编写的事件字母表和 部署时 LLM 推理。We formulate online prefix warning as monitor synthesis from raw LLM-agent traces and introduce PrefixGuard, which avoids hand-authored event alphabets and deployment-time LLM inference.

  • •

    键入的跟踪表示。Typed trace representation.StepView 使用一次性离线适配器来公开行动后证据 在固定字段中，允许相同的警告目标运行 浏览器、对话、编码和 CLI 跟踪。StepView uses a one-time offline adapter to expose post-action evidence in fixed fields, allowing the same warning objective to run across browser, dialogue, coding, and CLI traces.

  • •

    有限状态可审计性的诊断边界。Diagnostic boundary for finite-state auditability.我们通过 GRU、Transformer 学习故障对齐的离散字母表， 和软 FSM 监视器，然后事后提取 DFA 来映射位置 有限状态审计仍然紧凑，并且精确的自动机 约束会失去警告信号或扩大审计面。We learn a failure-aligned discrete alphabet with GRU, Transformer, and soft-FSM monitors, then extract DFAs post hoc to map where finite-state audit remains compact and where exact automaton constraints lose warning signal or expand the audit surface.

  • •

    超越排名的部署诊断。Deployment diagnostics beyond ranking.我们配对 AUPRC 具有可观察性和第一警报诊断功能的上限，可将 排名尺度、可见的前缀证据和低 FAR 警报实用程序。We pair an AUPRC ceiling with observability and first-alert diagnostics to separate ranking scale, visible prefix evidence, and low-FAR alert utility.

2.  相关工作2.  Related Work

LLM-代理评估和评委。LLM-agent evaluation and judges.轨迹结束后，代理基准测试通过任务验证器分配成功Agent benchmarks assign success after the trajectory ends via a task verifier[46, 3, 20, 23]，以及LLM作为法官的方法, and LLM-as-judge methods[45]提供回顾性语义评估。offer retrospective semantic assessment.前缀卫士PrefixGuard相反，从结果标记的前缀中学习域校准的时间统计数据，在每个步骤中生成在线风险评分，而无需部署时 LLM 推理。instead learns domain-calibrated temporal statistics from outcome-labeled prefixes, producing online risk scores at each step without deployment-time LLM inference.

运行时验证和规范挖掘。Runtime verification and specification mining.经典的运行时验证和基于规范的监控Classical runtime verification and specification-based monitoring[18, 5, 4]监控针对特定领域信号和事件的形式属性的跟踪，同时进行规范挖掘monitor traces against formal properties over domain-specific signals and events, while specification mining[1, 21, 19]从观察到的行为推断可能的规范。 这两条线的工作都假设有稳定的观察词汇和形式主义。 这种假设打破了 LLM 代理跟踪，它混合了浏览器操作、工具调用和对话，跨越不断发展的格式。infers likely specifications from observed behaviors. Both lines of work assume a stable observation vocabulary and formalism. That assumption breaks on LLM-agent traces, which mix browser actions, tool calls, and dialogue turns across evolving formats.步视StepView用一次性 LLM 辅助归纳步骤替换手动模式创作，从少量原始跟踪示例生成类型化适配器，而无需部署时 LLM 依赖性。replaces manual schema authoring with a one-time LLM-assisted induction step, producing a typed adapter from a handful of raw trace examples with no deployment-time LLM dependency.

跟踪抽象和预测过程监控。Trace abstraction and predictive process monitoring.对话流提取Dialogue-flow extraction[9, 34]和预测过程监控and predictive process monitoring[36, 35]目标覆盖重复行为或类型化工作流事件，而不是异构跟踪上即将发生的故障风险。 基于警报的系统target coverage of recurrent behaviors or typed workflow events rather than imminent failure risk on heterogeneous traces. Alarm-based systems[13]将其扩展到规范性干预措施。 早期时间序列分类extend this to prescriptive interventions. Early time-series classification[10, 24]激发了我们的固定范围警告设置，其中积极因素是由终端故障之前的有限窗口定义的。 §motivates our fixed-horizon warning setup, where positives are defined by a finite window before terminal failure. §3在引入轨迹符号后形式化这个标签。formalizes this label after introducing trajectory notation.前缀卫士PrefixGuard将此设置应用于 LLM 代理跟踪，其中事件字母表和表示必须共同学习，而不是假定是固定的。applies this setup to LLM-agent traces, where the event alphabet and representations must be jointly learned rather than assumed fixed.

可审计的神经符号监视器。Auditable neural-symbolic monitors.从循环网络中提取的有限自动机Finite automata extracted from recurrent networks[40]，通过离散优化学习的可解释的 DFA 序列分类器, interpretable DFA sequence classifiers learned by discrete optimization[32]，以及AALpy学习框架, and the AALpy learning framework[25, 37]提供可检查的状态机。 这些方法在固定符号观察或可查询系统上运行，尚未应用于异构 LLM 代理跟踪上的在线前缀警告。supply inspectable state machines. These approaches operate over fixed symbolic observations or queryable systems and have not been applied to online prefix warning over heterogeneous LLM-agent traces.前缀卫士PrefixGuard使用事后 DFA 提取作为边界诊断。 学习的符号可以编译成校准的状态风险机器，但我们的交叉基准审计表明，只有当诱导自动机紧凑且风险分离时，精确的有限状态检查才保持可靠。 附录uses post-hoc DFA extraction as a boundary diagnostic. Learned symbols can be compiled into calibrated state-risk machines, but our cross-benchmark audit shows that exact finite-state inspection remains reliable only when the induced automaton is compact and risk-separating. 3.1.  诊断可观察性上限3.1.  A Diagnostic Observability Ceiling

在描述 PrefixGuard 之前，我们先描述对任何仅跟踪前缀警告方法的表示级别限制。 这里Before describing PrefixGuard, we characterize a representation-level limit on any trace-only prefix-warning method. Here可观察到的observable是关于当前前缀表示的声明，而不是关于了解未来验证者结果的声明。 可观察的失败前缀是一个积极的警告目标，其​​已经看到的痕迹包含可区分的证据，例如重复的工具错误、无效的重试、异常状态或明显偏离任务目标。 隐藏的失败前缀只有在事后看来才是正的：当前其可见踪迹像负前缀一样分布，并且失败证据仅出现在未来的步骤或终端验证者结果中。 基于流行率敏感的 PR 分析is a statement about the current prefix representation, not about knowing the future verifier outcome. An observable failed prefix is a positive warning target whose already-seen trace contains distinguishable evidence, such as repeated tool errors, invalid retries, abnormal state, or a clear drift away from the task goal. A hidden failed prefix is positive only in hindsight: at the current time its visible trace is distributed like a negative prefix, and the failure evidence appears only in future steps or in the terminal verifier outcome. Building on prevalence-sensitive PR analysis[11, 7, 8]和污染分布标签噪声模型and contaminated-distribution label-noise models[31, 22], 让, letπ∈[0,1]\pi\in[0,1]是在此表示中可观察到的正警告前缀的分数：be the fraction of positive warning prefixes that are observable in this representation:

4.  方法4.  Method

PrefixGuard 将原始 LLM 代理跟踪转换为在线故障警告监视器。 StepView 使用 LLM 辅助的离线适配器将异构原始步骤映射到规范记录中以实现固定模式。 可训练后端将事件抽象层与前缀警告监视器相结合。 它将 StepView 字段映射到学习的事件字母表和校准的前缀风险，并且后端可以实例化为 GRU、Transformer 或 soft-FSM。 辛苦学习的符号也可以编译到 PrefixGuard-DFA 中，用于有限状态审计诊断。PrefixGuard converts raw LLM-agent traces into online failure-warning monitors. StepView maps heterogeneous raw steps into canonical records using an LLM-assisted offline adapter for a fixed schema. The trainable backend combines an event abstraction layer with a prefix-warning monitor. It maps StepView fields to a learned event alphabet and calibrated prefix risks, and the backend can be instantiated as a GRU, Transformer, or soft-FSM. Hard learned symbols can also be compiled into PrefixGuard-DFA for finite-state audit diagnostics.

4.1.  StepView：法学硕士辅助适配器感应4.1.  StepView: LLM-Assisted Adapter Induction

来自不同代理基准的原始执行步骤以异构格式到达。 浏览器代理步骤可能在结构化操作字段中携带 CSS 选择器，而对话代理步骤可能携带嵌入对话轮次内的 JSON 工具调用。 手动编写特定于格式的解析器是劳动密集型的，并且如果没有新的工程工作就无法扩展到新的基准。Raw execution steps from different agent benchmarks arrive in heterogeneous formats. A browser-agent step might carry a CSS selector in a structured action field, while a dialogue-agent step might carry a JSON tool call embedded inside a conversation turn. Writing a format-specific parser by hand is labor-intensive and does not scale to new benchmarks without fresh engineering effort.

离线适配器感应。Offline adapter induction.StepView 使用固定输出模式上的一次性 LLM 辅助适配器归纳步骤取代了手动解析器创作。 给定从目标基准的训练轨迹中提取的样本包，LLM 提出了一个轻量级确定性适配器，即解析每个原始步骤的字段提取函数StepView replaces manual parser authoring with a one-time LLM-assisted adapter-induction step over a fixed output schema. Given a sample pack drawn from training trajectories of a target benchmark, an LLM proposes a lightweight deterministic adapter, namely a field-extraction function that parses each raw stepctc_{t}进入监视器使用的规范 StepView 记录：into a canonical StepView record consumed by the monitor:

sv​(ct)=(metadata,observation,action,tool,args,result,status).\texttt{sv}(c_{t})=\bigl(\,\texttt{metadata},\ \texttt{observation},\ \texttt{action},\ \texttt{tool},\ \texttt{args},\ \texttt{result},\ \texttt{status}\,\bigr).

诱导适配器在监视器训练之前固定并由所有下游模型使用。 验证和测试跟踪由这个固定解析器转换，没有部署时 LLM 推理，也没有步骤级注释。 我们仅检查生成的适配器的结构有效性，而不使用下游警告指标来修改字段提取逻辑。 附录The induced adapter is fixed before monitor training and used by all downstream models. Validation and test traces are converted by this fixed parser with no deployment-time LLM inference and no step-level annotation. We review the generated adapter only for structural validity, without using downstream warning metrics to revise the field-extraction logic. AppendixB.4给出了准确的字段映射、后备策略和已发布的适配器代码。gives the exact field mapping, fallback policy, and released adapter code.

4.2.  TF-IDF 步进编码器4.2.  TF-IDF Step Encoder

我们使用以下块以固定的字段标记顺序序列化每个 StepView 记录We serialize each StepView record in a fixed field-tagged order, using blocks such as元数据METADATA, 观察OBSERVATION, 行动ACTION, 和, and结果RESULT，并将生成的字符串视为 TF-IDF 的一个文档, and treat the resulting string as one document for TF-IDF[30]。 矢量化器仅适合训练步骤字符串，然后冻结以进行验证、测试和部署。 它增加了训练语料库中独特的 n-gram 的权重，同时减少了常见样板的权重。 我们使用一元词和二元词，保留顶部. The vectorizer is fit only on training-step strings and then frozen for validation, test, and deployment. It upweights n-grams that are distinctive across the training corpus while downweighting common boilerplate. 4.5.  提取的 DFA 监视器4.5.  Extracted DFA Monitor

为了探究学习到的字母表可以在多大程度上被压缩为精确的符号状态，硬符号To probe how far the learned alphabet can be compressed into exact symbolic state, the hard symbolszt=arg⁡maxk⁡αt,kz_{t}=\arg\max_{k}\,\alpha_{t,k}抽象层产生的结果可用于从训练轨迹中提取有限自动机。produced by the abstraction layer can be used to extract a finite automaton from training traces.

DFA提取。DFA extraction.训练后，我们使用硬符号对所有训练轨迹进行符号化，并拟合 RPNI 式自动机After training, we symbolize all training trajectories using hard symbols and fit an RPNI-style automaton[27]在结果符号序列上。 每个 DFA 状态都会根据保留的校准轨迹分配一个校准的风险评分。 当生成的自动机用作符号监视器时，它会在每个步骤后遵循 DFA 转换函数，并在当前状态风险超过阈值时发出警报。 此提取被报告为有限状态审计诊断。 我们并不认为单个整体式 DFA 同样适合所有基准测试。over the resulting symbol sequences. Each DFA state is assigned a calibrated risk score from held-out calibration trajectories. When the resulting automaton is used as a symbolic monitor, it follows the DFA transition function after each step and raises alerts when the current state risk exceeds a threshold. This extraction is reported as a finite-state audit diagnostic. We do not assume that a single monolithic DFA is equally suitable for all benchmarks.

5.  实验5.  Experiments

实验遵循章节中的四个问题The experiments follow the four questions from Section1。 RQ1 测试观察到的前缀是否包含警告信号，无需部署时 LLM 判断。 RQ2 询问 StepView 是否暴露原始文本控件之外的信号。 RQ3 衡量有限状态压缩在多大程度上保留警告信号和可审计性。 RQ4 从排名转向部署。 它将 AUPRC 患病率影响与可见证据和早期低 FAR 警报区分开来。 表. RQ1 tests whether observed prefixes contain warning signal without deployment-time LLM judging. RQ2 asks whether StepView exposes signal beyond the Raw-text control. RQ3 measures how far finite-state compression preserves warning signal and auditability. RQ4 moves from ranking to deployment. It separates AUPRC prevalence effects from visible evidence and early low-FAR alerts. Table2是主要证据表。 补充诊断见附录is the main evidence table. Supplementary diagnostics are in AppendixC–D.

6.  局限性和结论6.  Limitations and Conclusion

局限性。Limitations.PrefixGuard 根据执行轨迹综合监控，而不是完整的干预策略。警告仍然需要可见的前缀证据、低 FAR 可分离性以及警报后的部署操作。 固定地平线和 FAR 上限是评估控制，MPE 坐标是特定于探针和协议的诊断，而不是经过认证的群体PrefixGuard synthesizes monitors from execution traces rather than complete intervention policies. Warnings still require visible prefix evidence, low-FAR separability, and a deployment action after an alert. The fixed horizon and FAR caps are evaluation controls, and MPE coordinates are probe- and protocol-specific diagnostics rather than certified populationπ\pi估计。 有限状态路径仅在紧凑制度下才利于审计；部署可见上下文下的路由 DFA 提取仍然是未来的方向，而不是锁定测试部署声明（附录estimates. The finite-state path is audit-friendly only in compact regimes; routed DFA extraction under deployment-visible context remains a future direction, not a locked-test deployment claim (AppendixB.9).

结论。Conclusion.PrefixGuard 将异构代理跟踪映射到键入的 StepView 前缀中，学习故障对齐事件符号，并生成在线风险评分，而无需部署时 LLM 判断。 在四个基准中，类型化的行动后证据改善了对原始控制的警告，而可观察性和低 FAR 诊断揭示了高排名何时支持干预而不是终端窗口分类。PrefixGuard maps heterogeneous agent traces into typed StepView prefixes, learns failure-aligned event symbols, and produces online risk scores without deployment-time LLM judging. Across four benchmarks, typed post-action evidence improves warning over raw controls, while observability and low-FAR diagnostics reveal when high ranking supports intervention rather than terminal-window triage.

附录AAppendix A扩展相关工作Extended Related Work

LLM-代理评估和评委。LLM-agent evaluation and judges.

代理基准测试通常仅在轨迹结束后（通过特定于环境的任务验证器）分配成功Agent benchmarks usually assign success only after a trajectory has ended, either through environment-specific task verifiers[46, 3, 20, 23]或通过回顾性法学硕士法官协议or through retrospective LLM-as-judge protocols[45]。 自主评估器和细化系统在观察完整交互后类似地对已完成的尝试进行评分或改进. Autonomous evaluator and refinement systems similarly score or improve completed attempts after observing the full interaction[28]。 这些协议适用于基准评分，但它们不提供可部署的预警信号：将法官转换为在线监视器需要对每个前缀进行重复推理，并且法官仍然对原始异构历史而不是校准的时间状态进行推理。. These protocols are appropriate for benchmark grading, but they do not provide a deployable early-warning signal: converting a judge into an online monitor requires repeated inference on every prefix, and the judge still reasons over a raw heterogeneous history rather than a calibrated temporal state.前缀卫士PrefixGuard目标是互补设置。 它从结果标记的前缀中学习域校准的时间统计数据，并在每个步骤中发出在线风险评分，而无需部署时 LLM 推理。targets the complementary setting. It learns domain-calibrated temporal statistics from outcome-labeled prefixes and emits online risk scores at each step without deployment-time LLM inference.

运行时验证和规范挖掘。Runtime verification and specification mining.

经典的运行时验证和基于规范的监控检查已知信号和事件词汇表上形式属性的跟踪Classical runtime verification and specification-based monitoring check traces against formal properties over known signals and event vocabularies[18, 5, 4]。 相反，规范挖掘从观察到的执行中推断出可能的行为规则. Specification mining instead infers likely behavioral rules from observed executions[1, 21, 19]，最近的工作探索了运行时监视器和自主决策之间的闭环, and recent work has explored closing the loop between runtime monitors and autonomous decision making[33]。 这些工作线提供了正确的概念目标——监控不断发展的执行，而不是只对最终结果进行评分——但它们依赖于稳定的观察字母表、固定的形式主义或可查询的系统接口。 LLM 代理跟踪违反了这些假设：单次运行可以在不断发展的日志记录格式下混合浏览器操作、工具调用、对话轮次、shell 输出和特定于基准测试的元数据。. These lines of work supply the right conceptual goal–monitor an evolving execution rather than grade only the final outcome–but they rely on a stable observation alphabet, a fixed formalism, or a queryable system interface. LLM-agent traces violate these assumptions: a single run can mix browser actions, tool calls, dialogue turns, shell outputs, and benchmark-specific metadata under evolving logging formats.步视StepView通过从原始训练轨迹中引入一次类型化适配器，然后在监视训练和评估之前冻结确定性字段提取来解决此接口差距。addresses this interface gap by inducing a typed adapter once from raw training traces, then freezing deterministic field extraction before monitor training and evaluation.

跟踪抽象和前缀预测。Trace abstraction and prefix prediction.

对话流提取和工作流记忆方法恢复重复出现的对话或代理行为模式Dialogue-flow extraction and workflow-memory methods recover recurring conversational or agentic behavior patterns[9, 34, 39]。 预测性流程监控和规定性警报系统使用前缀来预测案件结果或触发结构化工作流程中的干预措施. Predictive process monitoring and prescriptive alarm systems use prefixes to anticipate case outcomes or trigger interventions in structured workflows[36, 35, 13]，而日志异常检测则从系统日志模板和事件序列中学习, while log anomaly detection learns from system log templates and event sequences[12, 15]。 早期时间序列分类进一步激发了固定范围预测，其中只有在最终事件之前做出的决策才有用. Early time-series classification further motivates fixed-horizon prediction, where a decision is useful only if made before the terminal event[10, 24]. 前缀卫士PrefixGuard使这种前缀预测观点适应 LLM 代理执行。 警告标签与终端故障之前的有限范围相关联，但事件字母表不是由流程引擎或日志解析器给出的；监控人员必须从打字的、部分特定于基准的步骤记录中了解表征和风险状态。adapts this prefix-prediction viewpoint to LLM-agent execution. The warning label is tied to a finite horizon before terminal failure, but the event alphabet is not given by a process engine or log parser; the monitor must learn representations and risk states from typed, partially benchmark-specific step records.

精确召回上限和污染分布。Precision-recall ceilings and contaminated distributions.

我们的可观测性上限最接近精确回忆曲线的度量理论工作和相互污染分布的统计工作。 PR 曲线对类别偏差特别敏感，其可实现区域与 ROC 几何形状不同，并且 AUCPR/AP 估计取决于插值约定Our observability ceiling is closest to metric-theoretic work on precision-recall curves and statistical work on mutually contaminated distributions. PR curves are especially sensitive to class skew, their achievable regions differ from ROC geometry, and AUCPR/AP estimation depends on the interpolation convention[11, 7, 8]。 另外，当观察到的分布是潜在成分的混合物并且混合物权重可识别时，不对称标签噪声、正未标签和混合比例估计工作研究. Separately, asymmetric label-noise, positive-unlabeled, and mixture-proportion estimation work studies when an observed distribution is a mixture of latent components and when the mixture weight is identifiable[6, 31, 22, 29]。 我们将这些想法结合在特定于前缀警告的诊断中：如果一部分失败的前缀在分布上与观察到的跟踪表示下的负数相同，则仅跟踪记分器无法将该隐藏组件排名在负数之上，从而引发依赖于流行率的 AUPRC 包络。. We combine these ideas in a prefix-warning-specific diagnostic: if a fraction of failed prefixes is distributionally identical to negatives under the observed trace representation, no trace-only scorer can rank that hidden component above negatives, inducing a prevalence-dependent AUPRC envelope.

可审计的神经符号监视器。Auditable neural-symbolic monitors.

有限状态模型对于在线监控很有吸引力，因为它们公开了一个紧凑的状态空间，可以在部署后进行检查。 先前的工作从循环网络中提取自动机Finite-state models are attractive for online monitoring because they expose a compact state space that can be inspected after deployment. Prior work extracts automata from recurrent networks[40]，通过离散优化学习可解释的 DFA 序列分类器, learns interpretable DFA sequence classifiers through discrete optimization[32]，并为可查询系统提供主动自动学习工具, and provides active automata-learning tooling for queryable systems[25, 37]。 这些方法通常假设固定的符号观察或访问可以回答成员资格/等价式查询的系统。. These methods typically assume fixed symbolic observations or access to a system that can answer membership/equivalence-style queries.前缀卫士PrefixGuard更保守地使用有限状态结构：学习的符号可以编译到校准的状态风险机器中，但 DFA 提取被视为审计工件，而不是作为每个基准测试都承认小型精确自动机的保证。 因此，我们的交叉基准结果将神经符号监控定位为有用的诊断边界：当诱导自动机紧凑且风险分离时，有限状态检查最强；而当异构迹线需要更大、不太集中的状态机时，有限状态检查则较弱。uses finite-state structure more conservatively: learned symbols can be compiled into calibrated state-risk machines, but DFA extraction is treated as an audit artifact rather than as a guarantee that every benchmark admits a small exact automaton. Our cross-benchmark results therefore position neural-symbolic monitoring as a useful diagnostic boundary: finite-state inspection is strongest when the induced automaton is compact and risk-separating, and weaker when heterogeneous traces require larger, less concentrated state machines.

B.6.  TF-IDF 编码B.6.  TF-IDF Encoding

步骤的所有 StepView 字段都连接成一个规范文本字符串。 单个 TF-IDF 矢量器适合训练分割中的这些步骤字符串，然后冻结以进行验证和测试编码。 TF-IDF 词汇量上限为All StepView fields for a step are concatenated into one canonical text string. A single TF-IDF vectorizer is fit on these step strings from the training split and then frozen for validation and test encoding. The TF-IDF vocabulary is capped atd=4096d=4096特点。 我们将其视为固定的表示预算，而不是基准调整的超参数：相同的上限用于所有 GRU、Transformer 和 FSM 运行以及提取的 DFA 审计。 该上限足够大，可以在字段标记序列化后保留特定于基准的一元组和二元组，但保持编码器紧凑并防止方法比较接收不同的词汇特征预算。features. We treat this as a fixed representation budget rather than a benchmark-tuned hyperparameter: the same cap is used for all GRU, Transformer, and FSM runs, as well as the extracted-DFA audits. The cap is large enough to retain benchmark-specific unigrams and bigrams after field-tagged serialization, but keeps the encoder compact and prevents method comparisons from receiving different lexical feature budgets.

减重遵循章节中的训练目标Loss weights follow the training objective in Section4.4: λpred=1.0\lambda_{\mathrm{pred}}=1.0和andλbalance=0.1\lambda_{\mathrm{balance}}=0.1适用于所有面向纸张的运行。 因此，平衡项是对学习事件字母表的弱的、固定的防崩溃约束，而不是特定于基准的调整旋钮。 它的作用是锐化每步符号分配，同时防止边缘符号崩溃；前缀警告二元交叉熵仍然是主要的训练目标。for all paper-facing runs. The balance term is therefore a weak, fixed anti-collapse constraint on the learned event alphabet, not a benchmark-specific tuning knob. Its role is to sharpen per-step symbol assignments while discouraging marginal symbol collapse; the prefix-warning binary cross-entropy remains the dominant training objective.

B.9.  自动跨基准 DFA 事后审计B.9.  Automated Cross-Benchmark DFA Posthoc Audit

为了将 DFA 检查证据与人类可解释性证据分开，我们对 WebArena 的现有锁定测试 DFA 工件进行了自动事后审计，To separate DFA inspection evidence from human interpretability evidence, we ran an automated posthoc audit over existing locked-test DFA artifacts for WebArena,τ2\tau^{2}-Bench、SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench。 审计报告校准了 DFA 指标、可信状态覆盖范围、警告状态计数以及五个最常见状态中路由前缀的集中度。-Bench, SkillsBench, and TerminalBench. The audit reports calibrated DFA metrics, trusted-state coverage, warning-state counts, and concentration of routed prefixes in the five most frequent states.

表Table9显示 WebArena 具有四个基准测试中最紧凑且风险分离的自动机。shows that WebArena has the most compact and risk-separating automaton among the four benchmarks.τ2\tau^{2}-Bench 结构紧凑，但其前 5 个状态覆盖了 92.0% 的前缀，因此审计面集中且诊断较少。 SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench 保留了较高的可信前缀覆盖范围，但分别扩展到 151 和 187 个状态，削弱了提取的 DFA 易于跨基准检查的说法。 该审核是全自动的；它不衡量人类的一致性、可操作性或注释的可靠性。-Bench is compact, but its top five states cover 92.0% of prefixes, so the audit surface is concentrated and less diagnostic. SkillsBench and TerminalBench preserve high trusted-prefix coverage but expand to 151 and 187 states, respectively, weakening any claim that the extracted DFA is uniformly easy to inspect across benchmarks. This audit is fully automatic; it does not measure human agreement, actionability, or annotation reliability.

表Table10报告 SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench 的仅验证路由 DFA 诊断，其中单个提取的 DFA 最大。 这些诊断使经过训练的监视器和硬符号协议保持固定，仅将事后 DFA 提取更改为部署可见的路由，并与仅路由校准基线进行比较。 他们认为分层或混合 DFA 提取可能会提高可审计性，但故意保留证据作为未来工作的动机，而不是锁定测试部署声明。reports validation-only routed-DFA diagnostics for SkillsBench and TerminalBench, where a single extracted DFA is largest. These diagnostics keep the trained monitor and hard-symbol protocol fixed, change only the post-hoc DFA extraction into deployment-visible routes, and compare against route-only calibration baselines. They suggest that hierarchical or mixture-of-DFA extraction may improve auditability, but the evidence is deliberately kept as future-work motivation rather than a locked-test deployment claim.

附录DAppendix D扩展消融结果Extended Ablation Results

本节收集了支持正文中四个实验轴的消融。 我们优先考虑一次改变一种机制的控制：用于可恢复信号的监督非顺序探测、用于 StepView 证据的场丢弃、用于标签几何形状的混淆控制以及 Transformer 后端的每种子故障。This section collects ablations that support the four experimental axes in the main text. We prioritize controls that change one mechanism at a time: supervised non-sequential probes for recoverable signal, field drops for StepView evidence, confound controls for label geometry, and per-seed breakdowns for the Transformer backend.

D.4。  连续 StepView 序列控制D.4.  Continuous StepView Sequence Controls

为了隔离 PrefixGuard 学习的离散事件抽象的贡献，我们运行了 WebArena 控件，该控件保留相同的 StepView TF-IDF 步骤向量和因果前缀监督，但删除了 Gumbel 符号器和面向自动机的离散字母表。 生成的连续序列模型使用因果 GRU 或因果 Transformer 直接从 StepView 嵌入中对前缀进行评分。 他们使用相同的WebArena拆分，To isolate the contribution of PrefixGuard’s learned discrete event abstraction, we ran WebArena controls that keep the same StepView TF-IDF step vectors and causal prefix supervision but remove the Gumbel symbolizer and automaton-facing discrete alphabet. The resulting continuous sequence models score prefixes directly from StepView embeddings using either a causal GRU or a causal Transformer. They use the same WebArena split,H=3H{=}3标签、种子、训练/内部校准协议、前端和 StepView 文本模式作为表中单种子监督的 WebArena 控件labels, seed, train/internal-calibration protocol, frontend, and StepView text mode as the single-seed supervised WebArena controls in Table17.

连续序列控制并不能解释 PrefixGuard 的 WebArena 性能：更强的连续 Transformer 控制达到 0.819 AUPRC，低于 PrefixGuard-GRU 的 0.900，接近更简单的 TF-IDF 前缀逻辑控制 (0.818)。 与此同时，池化 MLP 仍然是最强的受监督 WebArena 控制 (0.940)，因此 WebArena 声明应该被表述为一种权衡：PrefixGuard 保留在线顺序状态和面向自动机的离散结构，同时保留强大但不是表中最佳的预测准确性。The continuous sequence controls do not explain away PrefixGuard’s WebArena performance: the stronger continuous Transformer control reaches 0.819 AUPRC, below PrefixGuard-GRU’s 0.900 and close to the simpler TF-IDF prefix logistic control (0.818). At the same time, the pooled MLP remains the strongest supervised WebArena control (0.940), so the WebArena claim should be stated as a tradeoff: PrefixGuard preserves online sequential state and automaton-facing discrete structure while retaining strong, but not best-in-table, predictive accuracy.

D.5。  神经编码器诊断控制D.5.  Neural Encoder Diagnostic Controls

表Table18总结了用冻结密集编码器替换 TF-IDF 步进编码器的诊断控制。 我们将它们报告为负面诊断，而不是标题比较。 这些控制针对一个实际的设计问题：是否可以用更强大的现成语义嵌入模型替换固定词汇编码器，而不改变监控学习配方的其余部分。summarizes diagnostic controls that replace the TF-IDF step encoder with frozen dense encoders. We report them as negative diagnostics rather than headline comparisons. These controls target a practical design question: whether the fixed lexical encoder can be replaced by a stronger off-the-shelf semantic embedding model without changing the rest of the monitor-learning recipe.

在这些控制中，冻结的密集编码器不会改进监控管道，因此主要实验保留 TF-IDF 作为固定步长编码器。 结果与 PrefixGuard 中 StepView 的作用一致：字段标记的词汇文本包含许多稀疏但具有操作决定性的标记，例如工具名称、状态、错误片段、文件路径和特定于任务的标识符。 TF-IDF 直接在较小的固定特征预算下保留这些高精度词汇线索，而密集的句子/代码嵌入可以将它们平滑为对检索有用的语义表示，但与前缀级警告标签和下游符号归纳不太一致。 因此，我们将神经编码器视为一个单独的未来方向，而不是一种临时改进：要使它们具有竞争力，可能需要针对编码器进行微调、结构化字段池或为监控学习而定制的对比目标，而不仅仅是用冻结的嵌入检查点替换 TF-IDF。Across these controls, frozen dense encoders do not improve the monitor pipeline, so the main experiments keep TF-IDF as the fixed step encoder. The result is consistent with the role of StepView in PrefixGuard: field-tagged lexical text contains many sparse but operationally decisive tokens, such as tool names, statuses, error fragments, file paths, and task-specific identifiers. TF-IDF preserves these high-precision lexical cues directly under a small fixed feature budget, while dense sentence/code embeddings can smooth them into a semantic representation that is useful for retrieval but less aligned with prefix-level warning labels and downstream symbol induction. We therefore view neural encoders as a separate future direction rather than a drop-in improvement: making them competitive likely requires encoder-specific fine-tuning, structured field pooling, or contrastive objectives tailored to monitor learning, not just replacing TF-IDF with a frozen embedding checkpoint.

范围和注意事项。Scope and caveats.这种对齐是基于一名编码员在 WebArena 上对一颗种子进行的样本检查；它构成国家可解释性的初步证据，而不是经过验证的定性研究。 所有 6 个警告状态均可独立分配给不同的、语义一致的故障前兆类别，支持 DFA 状态捕获有意义的操作阶段而不是任意量化工件的主张。 未来的工作仍需对多个编码器、评估者间可靠性和轨迹级地面实况注释进行全面研究。This alignment is based on exemplar inspection by one coder for one seed on WebArena; it constitutes preliminary evidence of state interpretability, not a validated qualitative study. All 6 warning states were independently assignable to distinct, semantically coherent failure-precursor categories, supporting the claim that DFA states capture meaningful operational phases rather than arbitrary quantization artifacts. A full study with multiple coders, inter-rater reliability, and trajectory-level ground-truth annotations remains future work.

Thusτ2\tau^{2}-Bench 支持一个更狭隘的主张：提取的 DFA 状态仍然可以被分配连贯的行为标签，但有限状态审计是集中的，并且比 WebArena 上的审计弱。-Bench supports a narrower claim: extracted DFA states can still be assigned coherent behavioral labels, but the finite-state audit is concentrated and weaker than on WebArena.

SkillsBench 和 TerminalBench。SkillsBench and TerminalBench.

我们还使用现有的 SkillsBench R340 和 TerminalBench R341 工件在大型 DFA 基准上运行了相同的事后对齐程序。 由于这些自动机要大得多（151 和 187 个状态），因此我们报告有代表性的状态对齐，而不是要求完整的逐个状态的人类解释。 对于 SkillsBench，警告状态主要对应于脆弱的编码工作流程阶段：具体证据之前的早期高层意图 (q0)、脚本执行和环境探测 (q117)、依赖项或求解器修复 (q128)、输出工件验证 (q64) 以及回退/格式错误的输出处理 (q46)。 对于 TerminalBench，所有六种可信警告状态均已编码；他们专注于高风险的初始工具引导 (q0/q109)、早期 JSON/工具调用失败 (q57)、第二步实现设置 (q120)、不透明的低位置探测 (q29) 和后期迭代修复/评估 (q21)。We also ran the same posthoc alignment procedure on the large-DFA benchmarks using the existing SkillsBench R340 and TerminalBench R341 artifacts. Because these automata are much larger (151 and 187 states), we report representative state alignments rather than claiming a full state-by-state human interpretation. For SkillsBench, the warning states mainly correspond to fragile coding-workflow phases: early high-level intent before concrete evidence (q0), script execution and environment probing (q117), dependency or solver repair (q128), output-artifact verification (q64), and fallback/malformed-output handling (q46). For TerminalBench, all six trusted warning states were coded; they concentrate around high-risk initial tool bootstrapping (q0/q109), early JSON/tool-call failure (q57), second-step implementation setup (q120), opaque low-position probes (q29), and late iterative repair/evaluation (q21).

大基准对齐支持与表中自动审计相同的保守结论The large-benchmark alignments support the same conservative conclusion as the automated audit in Table9：状态通常是行为可命名的，但是当自动机扩展并且警告状态变得特定于任务/工具系列时，可审核性就会减弱。 SkillsBench 有 151 个状态，其中有 27 个可信警告状态，而 TerminalBench 有 187 个状态，只有 6 个可信警告状态；前五名国有股分别为59.6%和62.0%。 这些是有用的诊断工件，而不是独立的人类可解释性证据。: states are often behaviorally nameable, but auditability weakens when the automaton expands and the warning states become task/tool-family specific. SkillsBench has 151 states with 27 trusted warning states, while TerminalBench has 187 states with only 6 trusted warning states; their top-five state shares are 59.6% and 62.0%, respectively. These are useful diagnostic artifacts, not standalone human-interpretability evidence.

这种结构有两个警告。 首先，这些估计是有限样本诊断，而不是经过置信度认证的真实总体Two caveats follow from this construction. First, these estimates are finite-sample diagnostics rather than confidence-certified true populationπ\pi价值观。 其次，全前缀 MPE 对轨迹长度敏感：在长基准测试中，全前缀负池包含许多早期前缀，这些前缀很容易让探针与近端失败前缀分离，从而推动values. Second, full-prefix MPE is sensitive to trajectory length: on long benchmarks, an all-prefix negative pool contains many early prefixes that are easy for the probe to separate from near-end failed prefixes, which pushesπ^MPE\hat{\pi}_{\mathrm{MPE}}向上。 匹配的非最终审计减少了较长基准的此阶段工件。 WebArena 标记改为使用全前缀诊断，因为匹配的非终端限制仅留下 46 个保留的成功近端负数并产生粗略间隔，upward. The matched non-terminal audit reduces this stage artifact for the longer benchmarks.
